title: The Xtransceiver's calls: res/local_tvt/<table>.json
description: calls.json (ARCID_LOCAL_TVT_CALL_DATA, a/2/4/0) or scripts.json (ARCID_LOCAL_TVT_SCRIPT, a/2/3/4), the calls that local_tvt_calldata.c and local_tvt_scriptmode.c play. tools/data/local_tvt_data.py packs them.

calls.description: CALL_DATA_COUNT LocalTvtCallEntry: LocalTvtCallData_GetEntry takes the first whose person and call count are the person's and the count of calls the save data has made with them

call_count.description: The count of calls made with them before

background.description: Behind their face: their zone's, by its battle background (LocalTvtCallData_GetZoneBackground), or a fixed one (CALL_BACKGROUND_*)

zone.description: Where they are, whose weather picks the object of their face (LocalTvtCallData_GetZoneObject)

greeting_message.description: What they say first, a message of res/text/system/local_tvt_talk.txt by ID

bye_message.description: At the end, of the same file

extra_message.description: Another message, which some persons say, or null

unk12.description: LocalTvtCallEntry.unk12, which the code doesn't read

scripts.description: The story's calls: script n, from 1, is file n - 1, whose messages are those of TEXT_BANK_LOCAL_TVT_TALK + n, res/text/system/local_tvt_script_<n>.txt

persons.description: The person of each of LOCAL_TVT_FACES faces, null for none (LOCAL_TVT_PERSON_NONE); with the last two none the call has two faces. 6 and 9 are the player's face by gender, and 8 takes its name from the secret calls

zones.description: Where each face is, which picks its background and object

commands.description: The commands in order (sLocalTvtScriptCommands); the packer adds the SCRIPT_COMMAND_END after them

message.description: For talk: the message the face says, of the script's text file by ID

se.description: For se: the sound effect, which the code reads as a u8

param.description: For wait_se: its param, which the code doesn't read
